topic: The Pi Mystery: Counting Collisions to Calculate Digits
target_audience: High school students or undergraduates with basic physics and geometry knowledge

sections.title: Introduction: The Impossible Counting Problem
lecture_lines: Imagine a tiny block hitting a massive one.
They bounce, exchanging momentum and energy.
How many collisions occur before they separate?
Surprisingly, it reveals digits of pi.
animations: Fade in text 'Imagine a tiny block hitting a massive one' color #FFFFFF and display.
Highlight collision count region with Rect stroke #00FFFF at D3.
Fade in text 'Surprisingly, it reveals digits of pi' color #FFD700 at B3.
Animate final result at F3 with scale_factor=1.0.

sections.title: Prerequisite Physics: Conservation Laws
lecture_lines: These laws dictate the collision outcomes.
animations: Display text 'Physics relies on conservation laws' color #FFFFFF at B5.
Animate E = T + V equation at B4/B6 with color #FFD700.
Animate vector collision with arrow at C4/C6 color #00FF00.

sections.title: Mapping Physics to Geometry: The Phase Space
lecture_lines: Map velocities to a phase plane.
animations: Display phase_space_grid at C3/F5 with text 'Map velocities to a phase plane'.
Animate trajectory arc 'Collisions trace a circular arc' at D3 with color #00FFFF.
Animate reflection at C5 with color #FF4500 and highlight.

sections.title: The Emergence of Pi
lecture_lines: Mass ratios define the path angle.
animations: Display circle formula, color #FFFFFF, at B4.
Animate sweep 'Paths measure the circle's arc' color #FFD700 at B5/C6.
Show convergence highlight color #00FF00 at E5.

sections.title: Conclusion and Summary
lecture_lines: Physics acts as an analog computer.
animations: Display 'Physics acts as an analog computer' color #FFFFFF at B4/E6.
Show 'Geometry reveals digits of pi' color #FFD700 at F3.
Display 'Three point one four one...' at F5 color #FFFFFF.
